matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: FCOS performs object detection in a per-pixel fashion directly on the feature map, predicting class and bounding-box offsets at each location without anchor boxes.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: FCOS is an anchor-free and proposal-free one-stage object detector.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: FCOS surpasses anchor-based detectors such as RetinaNet on COCO without requiring anchor box hyperparameter tuning.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: FCOS outperforms the anchor-based counterpart RetinaNet by 2.4% in AP with the same backbone.

unmatched_a.a_claim_text_normalized: Anchor boxes introduce many hyperparameters and a large gap between positive and negative samples that complicates training of dense detectors.
